title: From Wikipedia to Wikidata (sample)
audience: general audience curious how Wikipedia's structured data works

scenes.title: Wikipedia: the free encyclopedia

actions.target: the sister-project links in the footer
actions.at: At the bottom of the portal

actions.target: the Wikidata link in the footer

scenes.narration: This is wikipedia dot org, the doorway to the free encyclopedia in hundreds of languages. Behind those articles sits a shared store of facts. At the bottom of the portal, the Wikidata link takes us there.

scenes.title: Wikidata: the free knowledge base

actions.target: the Related to current events section

scenes.narration: Wikidata is the free knowledge base that anyone can edit, with more than a hundred and twenty million data entities. Both people and machines can read it, and it feeds structured data to Wikipedia and its sister projects. Under Related to current events, let's open one item.

scenes.title: An item: Hexed

actions.target: the Hexed label and its description

scenes.narration: Every item has its own Q number. This one is Hexed, an upcoming Disney animated film. Its facts are written as statements: it is an animated film, released on the twenty-fifth of November, 2026, and directed by Fawn Veerasunthorn and Jason Hand. Further down, identifiers link it to IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes and dozens of other databases.
